events.notes: Every ScaleButton press (UIPanel default sfx). Designer button_all (press + release click) + a crisp ElevenLabs plastic flick above 2 kHz at -9 dB (2026-11-06: the snap a phone shows).
Small element pops in: tooltip, stamp, badge step, booster icon lands.
Every KitPopup window opens (KitPop). Designer open_popup.
Buy-booster popup and the stuck-help booster offer. Designer buy_booster_suggest (C major).
A booster bought with coins or an ad: a bubbly pickup bloop (ElevenLabs 2026-11-06; was sfx_Item_appears, no top end) + the sparkle.
Count-ups; code sets the pitch from the count (0.9 -> 1.45).
Each flying coin lands: Bus In coin, short, 5 st lower; code climbs a pentatonic run (owner 2026-10-26).
Denied: locked booster, no coins. Two soft wood knocks (Kenney CC0).
Coins burst out of a reward (CommerceRewardFly): five Bus In coin clinks on a pentatonic spread + a quiet jingle (2026-11-06; was sfx_popup_fly_coins).
A level starts (HudPanel.PlayIntro): a light sparkly pop as the level tab drops in, 0.1 s after the call, right after the screen fade's swoosh (ElevenLabs 2026-11-06; was never played).
Reward / relief sparkle (25 call sites: colour cleared, rewards, chests...): three stereo ElevenLabs takes (2026-11-06; was sfx_balloon_unlock_reward, 0 % above 6 kHz).
Panels and props sweeping (code sets pitch): two airy ElevenLabs swooshes (2026-11-06; was synth).
Shuffle colour cycling: one marimba C5 note per change (VCSL CC0), code climbs the pitch.

Tapped car drives off (also the fire truck). Code: pitch by size (bus 0.88, car 1.1). Two ElevenLabs REAL car launches: tyre chirp, engine revs up ~0.4 s, then recedes (owner 2026-11-07: 'real hơn'; were toy-car pull-aways). The tyres are in the recording, so no car_tire layer.

The Home bus braking: a short soft rubber roll, two ElevenLabs takes (2026-11-06; was game_tire, a 2.4 s screech). No longer layered under car_depart (2026-11-07: the real car launch has its own tyre chirp).

Blocked car nudges into the one in front (at the contact). The owner's bump (designer click_bus_inactive, wobble removed) under an ElevenLabs plastic knock (2026-11-06: the bump alone was 88 % below 300 Hz, silent on a phone).
Car still refuelling / booster refused: Bus In soft negative tap (no wobble).
Level intro: each parked vehicle drops in: a toy car on a rubber mat, three ElevenLabs takes so a lot lands as a patter (2026-11-06; was sfx_celebration_bounce).
Tap while the road is full (car cannot go): Bus In's soft car_negative thump (owner 2026-10-26: gentler than the old alarm).
Bus cargo full. Designer bus_finish_sound (G major chord, V of the music).
Marimba C5 (VCSL CC0) under bus_full; code climbs C pentatonic with consecutive completions.
Cargo lid slams on the full load (also the Home bus roof, the tower chest): a hollow tailgate thunk with a click, two ElevenLabs takes (2026-11-06; was synth).

A full vehicle zooms off the road (GameView.OnExiting, its launch kick): a REAL car roaring past and away with a doppler drop, two ElevenLabs takes with a phone exciter (owner 2026-11-07: 'real hơn'; 2026-11-06 was a toy race car peel-out).
Recorded sand loop while buses suck (level sqrt(flux) x 0.5, low-pass 3.2 -> 6.5 kHz with the flow). Restored 2026-10-26.
Granular synth pour under it (level sqrt(flux) x 0.36, pitch 0.85 -> 1.15). Restored 2026-10-26.
Filling-a-bottle resonance, pitch climbs with the fill.
Picture settling after a bite.
Fire truck waiting (ducks music 70 %). Real two-tone fire engine siren C5/G4, softened (Wikimedia, CC BY 4.0: credit).
Fuel counter ticks down: a liquid bloop (Pixel Bus), code raises the pitch towards 0.
Fuel station done, hose retracts. Designer sound_break_fuel.
Sweet completion layer: soft vibraphone E5 (VCSL CC0).
Key flies to its padlock (0.6 s tween); the designer key_lock is cut so its click lands at the arrival.
The key's flight (layer of mech_key_fly): the ElevenLabs swoosh pitched up (2026-11-06; was synth).
Padlock pops off (the click is in mech_key_fly): hand chime E5 (VCSL CC0).
Tap on a locked car. Designer sound_lock.
Shift car flips 180 deg (every departure while one is on the lot). Designer sound_shift_bus.
Next car rises out of the lift. Designer sound_lift (= dune audio, re-pitched -2 st).
Hydraulic hiss under the lift (ElevenLabs 2026-11-06; was synth).
Highway lane queue steps forward, barrier lifts. Designer sound_highway_lane (= dune audio, +3 st).
The lane barrier's plastic clack (ElevenLabs 2026-11-06; was synth).
Sand dune melts. Designer sound_dune + a granular sand slide.
Falling mark-tree shimmer under the dune (VCSL CC0).
All towed cars full, tow plates drop. Designer sound_break_link.
Tow chain snaps taut (first hit of sound_break_link, -3 st).
Fire truck saved: a happy beep-beep of a real truck horn (Bus Crowd).
Mystery car shows its colour. Designer sound_hidden.
A bus rolls out of the garage. Designer sound_garage.
Lift / lane / garage used up, sinks away (dune audio -7 st).
+1 road slot (HUD and pre-level): a chunky plastic piece clicking into place under a rising glass shimmer (ElevenLabs; was designer boost_1, a synthetic rising sweep).
Shuffle: a crisp riffle of a card deck in a soft swirl (ElevenLabs; was designer boost_3, synthetic bouncy chirps). The colour cycling keeps its marimba ticks (fx_blip).
Pick Up: the claw motor whirs down, the clamp clicks on the grip (0.30 s) and the motor lifts the car away (ElevenLabs; was designer boost_4, crossing synthetic sweeps).
Magic Wand fills the tapped bus: a wand swish into a fairy-dust twinkle (ElevenLabs; was designer boost_2), same family as the other boosters.
Pick Up / Wand armed, waiting for a target: an ElevenLabs rising sparkle on a glockenspiel G6 + marimba G5 ping (2026-11-06; was a synthetic Kenney pluck).
Stage cleared. Designer sound_wingame (C major).

Stage failed (before the revive offer), not the final jingle: a soft marimba E5-C5-A4 sigh (A minor) with a vibraphone A5 and a puff of air (VCSL CC0 + ElevenLabs, 2026-11-06; was sfx_result_fail_01, three stepped square tones).
Level Failed screen (player gave up). Designer sound_lose_game (A minor).
Revive brought the level back. Designer revive_sound.
Finale: the picture pours back into its frame. Designer sound_recreate_picture.
Light sweep over the rebuilt picture: rising mark trees (VCSL CC0).
Firework rocket climbs (cut from sound_firework_wingame).

Shell bursts: an ElevenLabs firework crack + crackle (heard on a phone) over the designer boom's low body (headphones), 3 takes (2026-11-07; the designer booms were 85-90 % under 300 Hz). 0 dB (owner 2026-11-08: +2 dB, it was a bit quiet) with fw_burst_big -1 and fw_crackle 0: the 7-shell show (VFX cd06039, 6 bursts + the grand within 1.3 s) sums to -0.84 dBTP centre-panned, LUFS-S max -10.7 (was -12.4).

The grand shell: a big ElevenLabs crack-and-boom with a long glitter (2026-11-07; was the designer's double boom, 85 % under 300 Hz). -1 dB (owner +2 dB on 2026-11-08, but the grand lands on two ringing bursts: at 0 dB the show touches 0 dBFS; -1 keeps 0.8 dB headroom at the same loudness).
Glitter after each burst (wingame crackle cluster + sound_firework_free fizz).
A cleared colour runs into the painting beneath the sand: a wet bristle swish (ElevenLabs 2026-11-06; was synth).

The picture's chord: one soft vibraphone note per colour (VCSL CC0, tuned to C6 and played an octave down so the run C5..A6 stays under pitch 3), an arpeggio by GameAudio.PaintBloom (2026-11-06; was a synth chime).
Road jammed, the fail clock running: a soft lub-dub that quickens (ElevenLabs + phone exciter 2026-11-06; was synth).
The jam broke before it failed the level: a relieved exhale, two ElevenLabs takes (2026-11-06; was synth); a sparkle too after a close call.
The pencil sketching the next picture on the home's drying line, looped while it draws: graphite on rough paper (ElevenLabs loop take 2026-11-06; was synth).
A wooden clothespin snaps onto the home's drying line: two ElevenLabs takes (2026-11-06; was synth).
A sheet on the home's drying line flaps: a tap, a gust, the line sliding; three ElevenLabs takes (2026-11-06; was synth).
The home's bus honks, beep-beep: a tap on it, the next sketch drawn; two ElevenLabs takes (2026-11-06; was synth).
The home's bus revs: it drives in on the beach, it pulls away into the level (ElevenLabs + phone exciter 2026-11-06; was synth).

A KitPopup leaves (KitPop.PlayOut): a soft bubbly pop as it vanishes, 0.15 s after the tap (GameAudio.PopupClose); skipped when a window opens, the screen changes or a purchase sting starts meanwhile, or under a screen fade (ElevenLabs, retuned onto F/A).
Win popup multiplier needle crossing a segment (its own event, not the count-up's ui_tick): from when it shows, first two sweeps only; code lifts the pitch with the multiplier.
A popup with bad news opens instead of the bubble (KitPop.Negative: quit / reset, purchase failed, no internet, don't give up): marimba G5 -> E5 (VCSL CC0).
A toast pops in (TipsToast; not again for one replacing a message shown < 0.8 s ago): a tiny glassy blip (ElevenLabs).
A settings switch flips on (KitToggle): a crisp plastic flick (ElevenLabs).
A settings switch flips off: another flick, a semitone lower (ElevenLabs).
The screen fade covers a change of screen (ScreenFade: Home <-> level, next level, restart): a wide soft swoosh, two ElevenLabs takes.
A chest / daily bar fills: a rising shimmer (ElevenLabs); code lifts the pitch with the fill.
The rescue clock's last 15 s: a wooden tock per second, louder and higher towards 0 (ElevenLabs).
A small positive step: a tutorial step done, a heart from an ad. Two soft bell notes on C6 (ElevenLabs).
A row of things popping in (daily cards, Rewards! prizes, rating stars, hearts / boosters landing): the ui_pop clip, code climbs a pentatonic run.
Something heavy lands on the UI (the win chest dropping in, the tower lift touching down): the cargo-lid thunk 3 st lower.
Quit / reset: the broken heart cracks as it shakes (ElevenLabs glass crack).
A real-money purchase went through (shop, starter, special gift, no ads): glockenspiel C-E-G-C (VCSL CC0) + Bus In coins + ElevenLabs shimmer; the music ducks to 55 % for 1.2 s.
A reward chest shakes (win chest, tower chest charge): wooden knocks with coins inside (two ElevenLabs takes layered); was a tick / a whoosh.
A reward chest bursts open (win chest, tower chest): the lid + a magical burst (two ElevenLabs takes layered); was the battle-pass unlock clip / the bus lid + a sparkle.
The armed Pick Up / Wand tapped again (cancelled): the arm sparkle a fourth lower and softer.
The homecoming's paint grains land on the sheet (HomeAtelier): a soft wet patter (ElevenLabs).
The home's bus settles on its springs as it stops, nose dipping (HomeBus): a soft creak (ElevenLabs).
The Home beach's sea (HomeStage, loop): a 12 s stereo ElevenLabs loop take under the Home music, in with the Home, out under a loading screen.
Home: ukulele / marimba beach pop (C major, 99 BPM, 110 s) and kalimba / glockenspiel / e-piano (C major, 92 BPM, 110 s), ElevenLabs Music; -15 LUFS -> about -24 in the mix.

In game: marimba / pizzicato / pads (C major, 120 s) and lo-fi e-piano / vibraphone (A minor, 85 BPM, 120 s), ElevenLabs Music; about -27 LUFS in the mix under the sand bed and the cars; ducks a further 35 % under heavy pouring.
Battle Royale result: a party popper + confetti on a glockenspiel C6-E6-G6-C7 run (2026-11-06; was sfx_anim_celebration, 8-bit)
Yacht Racing reward finale: a slow marimba + glockenspiel C major roll, wind chimes, confetti (2026-11-06; was sfx_ui_haidao_celebration_finale, 8-bit)
Climb Tower reward unlocked: a rolled marimba C5-E5-G5-C6, glockenspiel C7, wind chimes (2026-11-06; was sfx_balloon_unlock_reward, 8-bit)
Pass reward unlocked: the rolled marimba unlock (2026-11-06; was sfx_battlepass_reward_unlock, 8-bit)
Reward claimed: glockenspiel G6 -> C7 on marimba C5, a sparkle tail (2026-11-06; was sfx_battlepass_claim_reward, 8-bit)
Streak reward pops up: the claim chime (2026-11-06; was sfx_progress_bar_The_reward_pops_up, 8-bit)
Streak rewards doubled: a marimba octave 'ba-ding' with a coin and a glockenspiel C7 (2026-11-06; was sfx_Items_doubled, 8-bit)
First place: a glockenspiel C6..C7 run onto marimba C5 + G5 (2026-11-06; was sfx_ui_leaderboard_top, 8-bit)
Gold pass maxed: a strummed glockenspiel C major chord, a C7 bloom, wind chimes (2026-11-06; was sfx_bp_gold_max_reach, 8-bit)
Reward items (not coins) burst out: soft bubbly pops and a sparkly swish (ElevenLabs) (2026-11-06; was sfx_popup_fly_items, 8-bit)
Reward items land in their bag: a soft pouch thump + a tiny glockenspiel C7 (ElevenLabs + VCSL) (2026-11-06; was sfx_rewards_fly_bag, 8-bit)
An event icon reaches the side bar: the pouch catch (2026-11-06; was sfx_balloon_in_sidebar, 8-bit)
A boat moves up the race: a magical rising swoosh (ElevenLabs, two takes) (2026-11-06; was sfx_ani_racing_up, 8-bit)
Climb Tower balloon rises: the rising swoosh (2026-11-06; was sfx_balloon_ascend_01, 8-bit)
Battle Royale avatars appear: the rising swoosh (2026-11-06; was sfx_ui_avatar_appear, 8-bit)
Yacht Racing reward appears: the rising swoosh (2026-11-06; was sfx_ui_haidao_celebration_appear, 8-bit)
Streak item appears: the rising swoosh (2026-11-06; was sfx_Item_appears, 8-bit)
Climb Tower balloon drops back: a soft falling whoosh (ElevenLabs fall + a reversed shimmer) (2026-11-06; was sfx_balloon_descend_01, 8-bit)
Battle Royale player drops out: the falling whoosh (2026-11-06; was sfx_anim_fail_drop_down, 8-bit)
Battle Royale lava slides down: a warm lava rumble (phone exciter) with a shimmer sweeping down (2026-11-06; was sfx_ui_rongyan_descend, 8-bit)
Yacht Racing trophy bounce (every 1.33 s): a soft thump with a metallic ting (ElevenLabs) (2026-11-06; was sfx_celebration_bounce, 8-bit)
Climb Tower bar fills: the game's rising fill shimmer (2026-11-06; was sfx_balloon_progress_fill, 8-bit)
Streak bar segment fills: the fill shimmer (2026-11-06; was sfx_progress_bar_fill_up_1, 8-bit)
Battle Royale round complete: two soft bells on C6 (2026-11-06; was sfx_ui_score_complete, 8-bit)
Battle Royale count-up: the woodblock tick (2026-11-06; was sfx_ui_score_tick, 8-bit)
Battle Royale text line: a quiet woodblock tick (2026-11-06; was sfx_ui_rongyan_text, 8-bit)
No-ads offer shows: the designer's C major offer sting (was 4 s of square chords) (2026-11-06; was sfx_noadds, 8-bit)
Yacht Racing race view (loop, YachtRacingUi.PlayLoop): sea and distant boat engines (ElevenLabs loop) (2026-11-06; was sfx_amb_racing_loop, 8-bit)
Yacht Racing start view (loop): the sea and boats loop (2026-11-06; was sfx_ui_haidao_loading_loop, 8-bit)
Battle Royale avatars fly off with their propellers: a light toy propeller whirr (ElevenLabs) (2026-11-07; was sfx_propeller_spin, white noise)
Streak reward items fly back to the bar: airy whooshes, the old clip's 0.415 s lead kept for the panel's timing (ElevenLabs) (2026-11-07; was sfx_Items_fly_back_to_the_progress_bar, white noise)
